row:
Every animal deserves a chance to live in safety, free from hunger, pain, and neglect. I'm Ali, an animal rescuer and I made it my mission to do everything I can to provide that chance.

Me and my team rescue, shelter, feed, and care for animals that have nowhere else to turn. Many are injured, sick, abandoned, or in urgent need of help. Every rescue is different, but our goal is always the same: to give them the care, protection, and dignity they deserve.

I'm the one who receives the funds which are being spent on the many costs involved in continuing our work, including:

• Animal Care
• Medical Equipment and Treatment
• Rescue Operations and Transports
• Shelter Infrastructure
• Operational Costs
• Volunteer & Staff Support
